title: Revisiting WEASEL 2.0: Reproduction, Sensitivity, and an Adaptive Ensemble-Size Rule
abstract: arXiv:2608.18021v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: WEASEL 2.0 is a dictionary-based time series classifier that combines dilated sliding windows with a randomised hyperparameter ensemble and a fixed-size dense feature representation. Two of its hyperparameter choices, the maximum ensemble size and the maximum window size, are specified by simple thresholding rules whose chosen thresholds are not empirically justified in the original paper. In this work we reproduce WEASEL 2.0 on 114 UCR datasets, achieving a mean accuracy of 0.865 and median of 0.928, closely matching the published values (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p = 0.655). We then test the sensitivity of four design choices: the downstream classifier, the absence of feature weighting, the maximum window-size rule, and the maximum ensemble-size rule. The first three are robust to perturbation. The fourth is over-provisioned for long-series datasets, motivating an adaptive rule that sets the maximum ensemble size from series length and num

translated_title: 重访WEASEL 2.0：复现、敏感性与自适应集成规模规则
translated_abstract: 摘要：WEASEL 2.0是一种基于字典的时间序列分类器，它结合了膨胀滑动窗口、随机化超参数集成以及固定大小的稠密特征表示。其两个超参数选择，即最大集成规模和最大窗口大小，由简单的阈值规则指定，但所选阈值在原始论文中并未得到经验性验证。在本工作中，我们在114个UCR数据集上复现了WEASEL 2.0，实现了平均准确率0.865和中位数0.928，与已发表值高度吻合（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p = 0.655）。随后，我们测试了四个设计选择的敏感性：下游分类器、特征加权的缺失、最大窗口大小规则以及最大集成规模规则。前三个对扰动具有鲁棒性。第四个在长序列数据集上过度配置，这促使我们提出一种自适应规则，该规则根据序列长度和类别数量来设置最大集成规模。
tldr: 本文复现WEASEL 2.0并验证其性能，发现最大集成规模规则在长序列数据上过度配置，进而提出基于序列长度和类别数的自适应规则。
en_tdlr: This paper reproduces WEASEL 2.0 and validates its performance, finding that the maximum ensemble-size rule is over-provisioned for long-series data, and proposes an adaptive rule based on series length and class count.
